author: Mohammad Yeasin
subject: grammar
title: Present Perfect Tense
learning_outcomes: Understand when to use the Present Perfect
Form sentences with have/has + past participle
Talk about past experiences with present relevance

quiz.question: Which is the correct sentence?
quiz.explanation: Use 'has' for He/She/It, and past participle for the verb.

faq.q: When do we use the Present Perfect?
faq.a: For past actions with a connection to now.
